correctness.rationale: An exact full-coverage proof enumerates the Eulerian frequency vectors by the independent constraints e=b, g=d, f=c+d-b, a+b+2c+3d+h=16. The directed BEST theorem with factorial division applies on each strongly connected support. All 226 full-four-vertex and 45 degenerate profiles are separately enumerated. An independent brute-force implementation evaluates all 65536 indexed words; both produce identical 271-row profiles, unique maximum 1296, unique runner-up 1280, and total 65536. Executed directly from packaged candidate paths; no extrapolation beyond n=16.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the unique global maximum over all 271 cyclic order-two binary Markov profile fibers at length 16 and the exact runner-up. Existing formulae for a fixed Markov type and the uniform multi-de Bruijn fiber already yield its count 1296, but the inspected primary texts count types, construct codes, or count the prescribed uniform class, rather than compare it with every nonuniform frequency vector. Seven actual semantic searches plus literature aliases, mathematical reductions and exact-table lookups found no dominating statement; this is positive but non-definitive evidence, and earlier unpublished or unindexed enumerations remain possible.
residual_risks: An older type-class census, author database or unindexed enumeration could have recorded the same 271-profile comparison.
The complete 2023 cross-join article was not accessible in rendered full text; its stated theorem is confined to uniform-profile cycles.
The 1296 uniform-fiber value is already known; scientific originality depends on the *global extremality and unique runner-up*, not that value alone.
No independent external audit or independent literature sign-off is claimed.

value.rationale: The exact worst-case ambiguity of the full cyclic three-gram count observation at the first twice-complete binary coverage length is a motivated information-theoretic reconstruction invariant. It resolves the global mode among 271 realizable Markov types, not merely the previously known count for one uniform class. The small gap 1296 versus 1280 and reversal from nonuniform mode at first coverage length 8 expose a meaningful structural boundary; this finite classification is self-contained and may benchmark cyclic assembly/reconstruction design. Not an unsupported extension to arbitrary lengths.
